title_sq: Ne Don Bosko, Tek Twister Rezidence, Shitet Apartament 3+1+2+Verande, Me Orientim Perfekt Dhe Super Pamje !
description_sq: Ne Don Bosko, Tek Twister Rezidence, Shitet Apartament 3+1+2 + Verande, Me Orientim Perfekt dhe Super Pamje ! Apartamenti me siperfaqe totale 186.1 m2, nga te cilat 115 m2 neto, 48.61 verande dhe 22,49 hapsire e perbashket ndodhet ne katin e 9-te te nje pallati 10-katesh me ashensor. Organizimi i apartamentit eshte si me posht: Salloni i bollshem me kuzhine te vecuar dhe me dalje ne verande ,dy dhoma gjumi femijesh dhe dhoma matrimoniale me garderobe dhe tualet, tualeti i dites, lavenderia dhe dy veranda. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte Lindje-Jug-Perendim cka i mundeson ndricim dhe diell gjate gjithe dites. Pallati ne te cilin ndodhet apartamenti dallohet per punimet cilesore, duke filluar nga instalimet hidraulike inkaso, instalimet e sistemit te kondicionimit multisplit, shtrimi me parket ose me pllake, dritare dopioxham termike etj. Ndertimi aktualisht ndodhet ne perfundim te fazes se fasades dhe parashikohet dorezimi i tij deri ne fund te vitit.
title_en: In Don Bosko, at Twister Residence, Apartment 3+1+2+Veranda for sale, with perfect orientation and great view!
description_en: In Don Bosko, at Twister Residence, Apartment 3+1+2 + Porch for sale, with perfect orientation and great view! The apartment with a total area of ​​186.1 m2, of which 115 m2 net, 48.61 veranda and 22.49 common space is located on the 9th floor of a 10-story building with an elevator. The organization of the apartment is as follows: spacious living room with separate kitchen and exit to the veranda, two children's bedrooms and matrimonial room with wardrobe and toilet, day toilet, laundry room and two verandas. The orientation of the apartment is East-South-West, which allows light and sun throughout the day. The building in which the apartment is located stands out for its quality works, starting from inkaso plumbing installations, multisplit air conditioning system installations, flooring with parquet or tiles, thermal double-glazed windows, etc. The building is currently at the end of the facade phase and it is expected to be delivered by the end of the year.
